description: This Java class defines an error type 'DeserializationStrategyNotFoundError' used to indicate that no deserialization strategy could be found for a specific class. It extends the Error class and provides constructors to specify the class for which the strategy was missing, optionally including a cause.

classes.name: DeserializationStrategyNotFoundError
classes.description: An error class for reporting the fact that for a particular type a deserialization strategy could not be found.

methods.name: DeserializationStrategyNotFoundError(Class<?> entityClass)
methods.description: Constructor that creates the error indicating no deserialization strategy for the specified class.

methods.name: DeserializationStrategyNotFoundError(Class<?> entityClass, Throwable cause)
methods.description: Constructor that creates the error with an underlying cause.
